resolutions.researcher_notes: Original ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn approval notice) is dead: the whole gxzf.gov.cn domain (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn AND dnr.gxzf.gov.cn) ConnectTimeouts from this sandbox -- consistent with the brief's geo-block note. Checked web.archive.org: no snapshot exists for this specific approval-notice path (CDX exact-match query returns empty; only the fgw.gxzf.gov.cn homepage has old snapshots) -- a legitimate no-snapshot case, not a retry-harder case. Fresh Chinese search found no alternate working URL republishing the approval notice. Substituting the sheet's own verified Guangxi Daily/Guangxi News Net groundbreaking article (2020-04-30, '南宁：天然气专供管道工程项目开工'), already used elsewhere on this row and re-verified here (200 OK, tokens 中燃/邕宁/蒲庙/8.9 present). It confirms the project broke ground 2020-04-28 with a firm 8-month construction schedule (implying ~Dec 2020 completion, matching the sheet's own StartYear1=2020/StartMonth1=12), committed funding (6755万元), and government-priority status, with zero contrary signal (no delay/shelving/cancellation found anywhere in a fresh search for post-2020 news on this segment). This is support for 'operating' by schedule-completion + absence-of-contrary-evidence, not a direct post-commissioning confirmation, hence medium not high tier -- flagging that a human with browser access to gxzf.gov.cn, or a dedicated completion-announcement search, could firm this up to high.

Original ref (news.bjx.com.cn/html/20210326/1144324-4.shtml) is unreadable, not merely offline: fetched it directly (curl) and also pulled it via web.archive.org (both the live host and IA's own on-demand capture of the -4 page) -- all three return the identical Aliyun-WAF JS-challenge blob (renderData/arg1 obfuscation, zero article text). An earlier-dated IA snapshot (2021-04-10) exists only for the base page (no '-4' suffix, i.e. page 1 of what the URL structure implies is a 4-page article) and IS readable: it is '附171个电源项目全名单！《广西能源网建设2021年工作推进方案》' (Guangxi DRC's 2021 'Energy Network' work plan, doc 桂发改电力〔2021〕184号, dated 2021-03-15), a province-wide policy notice covering 171 power projects + gas pipeline construction totals in aggregate -- it does NOT name this specific Sinopec Nanning Station-Zhongran Gate segment anywhere in the readable page-1 text (the segment, if listed at all, would be in the unreachable page-4 appendix table). Separately, and more importantly: fresh Chinese search for the project's actual approval history (multiple independent search snippets of the gxzf.gov.cn approval notice title, plus the natural-resources-bureau land-use pre-review page at dnr.gxzf.gov.cn) consistently gives the approval document as 南发改报〔2019〕623号, issued 2019-11-19 -- i.e. approved in 2019, which precedes and is inconsistent with a 2021-03 Proposal date on a project that had ALREADY broken ground 2020-04-28. This is a disagreement with the recorded ProposalYear=2021/ProposalMonth=3, not merely an access gap, so per the no-different-value rule I am not proposing a replacement ref or date -- flagging the sequencing conflict (Proposal 2021 > Construction-start 2020, and approval evidence points to 2019) for the value-change workflow rather than resolving it here. Could not independently re-verify the 2019-11-19 approval date itself through url_verifier this pass (same gxzf.gov.cn block, no snapshot -- see Capacity/Pressure/Diameter units).

Per standing rule, not fabricating/citing a URL I can't pass through url_verifier -- this is a legitimate no-snapshot UNRESOLVED, value itself is not in dispute (search snippets consistently corroborate 0.67 bcm/y, just not via a citable working URL).
